map.输入：静息收集 5 分钟得唾液 0.8mL\n计算：静息流率 = 0.8 / 5:
Input: resting collection 5 min yields 0.8mL saliva
Calculation: resting flow = 0.8 / 5 = 0.16 mL/min
Note: below about 0.1 mL/min suggests obvious dry mouth; check drug/disease/radiotherapy factors.
map.静息约 0.3~0.5 mL/min，刺激可达 1~2 mL/min；低于静息: Resting about 0.3-0.5 mL/min, stimulated up to 1-2 mL/min; below resting 0.1 mL/min is mostly obvious dry mouth (reduced saliva).
map.静息和刺激流率区别？: What is the difference between resting and stimulated flow?
map.静息为非刺激基础分泌，刺激为酸/咀嚼诱导；二者都低提示腺功能整体下降，仅静息低可: Resting is unstimulated basal secretion, stimulated is acid/chewing induced; both low suggests overall gland decline, only resting low may be collection-condition difference.
map.口干怎么办？: What to do about dry mouth?
map.排查药物、自身免疫（如干燥综合征）、放疗等；可刺激唾液、人工唾液与保湿；持续口干: Check drugs, autoimmunity (e.g. Sjogren), radiotherapy, etc.; can stimulate saliva, use artificial saliva and moisturizers; for persistent dry mouth visit oral-mucosa/rheumatology.
